raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Two independent changes that cut MiniMax-M3 decode time on MI355X under agentic (long-context, EAGLE3) load:

1. **Long extend-prefill rows on AITER fp8 FMHA v3** (`ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN`, gfx950, fp8 KV cache, opt-in via `VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q`, default 0 = off). Unified attention runs every row through AITER's triton `unified_attention`, which is built for decode; on a long extend-prefill chunk over a long context it reaches ~0.7–0.8 PFLOP/s, while AITER's FMHA v3 fp8 kernel runs chunks of 4K+ new tokens 1.7–2.7x faster.
   - The metadata builder splits the batch on the host: requests whose query has at least `MIN_Q` tokens (prefill chunks; decode / spec-decode rows never qualify) become "long" rows.
   - For the long rows, the layer gathers their fp8 K/V (context + new tokens, already in the paged cache) into contiguous tensors and calls the fp8 FMHA v3 varlen kernel (bottom-right causal) with the layer's statically quantized fp8 query — the same query unified attention reads.
   - The remaining rows run `unified_attention` as a compact batch. Unsupported configurations (sinks, ALiBi, soft cap, sliding window, shuffled KV layout, head size other than 64/128, fused output quant) keep the current path, and CUDA graph capture never takes the split.
   - In MiniMax-M3 this backend serves the 3 dense full-attention layers and the EAGLE3 draft layer (the 57 sparse layers use their own kernels).

2. **`draft_lm_head_quantization` for a drafter's own lm_head.** The option only applied when the drafter shares the target's `lm_head`; a drafter that ships its own head (e.g. `Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3-GQA`, whose head differs from the target's) was rejected with a `ValueError`, so its bf16 head (614 MB per rank at TP4) is read in full three times per step. This PR quantizes that head instead, with the same online methods (`fp8`: per-row weight / per-token activation scales; `nvfp4`: weight-only W4A16). The shared-head path is unchanged and moves into `resolve_draft_lm_head`. As in the shared case, the bf16 source head stays resident for `refresh_quantized_lm_heads` / draft weight updates, so the copy adds memory (307 MB per rank here).

## Kernel results (MI355X, one TP4 rank of a MiniMax-M3 dense layer: 16 q heads, 1 KV head, d=128, fp8 KV, block 128)

ms per call; the FMHA column includes the fp8 K/V gather (0.04–0.10 ms).

| context | new tokens | unified_attention | FMHA fp8 (this PR) | cosine vs unified |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 64K | 4,096 | 3.14 | 1.87 (−40%) | 0.99971 |
| 64K | 8,192 | 5.49 | 2.04 (−63%) | 0.99971 |
| 160K | 2,048 | 3.88 | 4.25 (+9%) | 0.99969 |
| 160K | 4,096 | 7.16 | 4.23 (−41%) | 0.99969 |
| 160K | 8,192 | 13.48 | 5.27 (−61%) | 0.99969 |
| 160K | 16,384 | 26.26 | 10.39 (−60%) | 0.99968 |

Below ~3K new tokens FMHA does not win, so the E2E runs use `MIN_Q=3072`.

## E2E (MI355X, MiniMax-M3-MXFP4, TP4, EAGLE3-GQA K=3)

This PR = `VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q=3072` + `draft_lm_head_quantization: fp8`. Base: vLLM nightly `8e2beaa3` with the MiniMax-M3 model code from main `4643f41` + #62509 + #62614 + #62846, FFN monokernel on (`--monokernel`, plus two local commits that let it take #62509's FP8 projections); the baseline is the same image without this PR. AgenticX: InferenceX recipe `minimaxm3/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml`, 3600 s, synthetic acceptance (AL 2.78); in each row the baseline and the change ran concurrently on the two GPU halves of one node (start times up to 25 minutes apart), one run each. Three baseline runs at C24 spread 0.1% (throughput), 0.8% (P50), 3% (P90), 0.7% (TPOT). Cells are baseline → change.

| Conc | Change | Throughput/GPU (tok/s) | P50 interactivity | P90 interactivity | Mean TPOT |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 20 | this PR | 34,834 → 34,936 (+0.3%) | 226.3 → 234.0 (+3.4%) | 146.6 → 154.2 (+5.2%) | 4.79 → 4.60 ms (−4.0%) |
| 24 | this PR | 41,350 → 41,766 (+1.0%) | 192.8 → 198.5 (+3.0%) | 112.1 → 122.5 (+9.3%) | 5.83 → 5.58 ms (−4.3%) |
| 28 | this PR | 45,617 → 45,922 (+0.7%) | 177.6 → 182.8 (+2.9%) | 101.3 → 103.2 (+1.9%) | 6.37 → 6.24 ms (−2.0%) |
| 24 | FMHA only | 41,356 → 41,598 (+0.6%) | 194.4 → 197.6 (+1.6%) | 114.9 → 121.2 (+5.5%) | 5.79 → 5.60 ms (−3.3%) |
| 24 | draft head only | 41,332 → 41,446 (+0.3%) | 192.9 → 197.4 (+2.3%) | 115.7 → 117.3 (+1.4%) | 5.79 → 5.69 ms (−1.7%) |

Prefill chunks share steps with decode rows, so faster dense-layer prefill also lowers TPOT; the draft head change saves about half of the head's ~0.3 ms per step. Single-request TTFT on a cached 160K prefix (FMHA only, averaged over runs on both GPU halves of one node): 8,192 new tokens 322 → 297 ms, 16,384 new tokens 492 → 462 ms (the halves alone differ by up to ~25 ms, so read these as ±10 ms).

**Accuracy and acceptance (GSM8K)**, InferenceX `gsm8k.yaml`, 5-shot, all 1,319 questions, real EAGLE3 acceptance (AL = 1 + 3 · accepted / drafted over the whole run). GSM8K prompts are short, so the FMHA row sets `MIN_Q=64` to send every prefill through the FMHA path (the fp8 FMHA kernel is loaded in the server log):

| | strict-match | flexible-extract | acceptance length |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| baseline | 95.45% | 95.38% | 3.32 |
| this PR | 95.91% | 95.83% | 3.35 |
| FMHA only, `MIN_Q=64` | 95.45% | 95.38% | 3.39 |
| draft head only | 96.21% | 96.13% | 3.38 |

Standard error ±0.55%; acceptance length varies by about ±0.03 between runs of the same image.

## Test plan

- `tests/v1/attention/test_rocm_aiter_unified_attn_fmha_extend.py`: host row split (long / short rows, KV row indices, spec-decode rows excluded); on gfx950, the backend output with the FMHA path matches the unified-attention path for mixed batches (1 and 2 KV heads). 3 passed on MI355X.
- `tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_draft_lm_head.py`: an own-head drafter gets a quantized copy of its own head (not the target's); without quantization it keeps its head; quantization without any head raises. 7 passed, 4 skipped (nvfp4 cases) on MI355X.
- MiniMax-M3 serving (AgenticX and GSM8K above).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN: long extend-prefill rows on AITER's fp8 FMHA v3."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata
+
+BLOCK = 128
+HEAD = 128
+
+
+def _metadata(q_lens, seq_lens, device, num_blocks):
+    qsl = [0]
+    for q in q_lens:
+        qsl.append(qsl[-1] + q)
+    max_blocks = max(-(-s // BLOCK) for s in seq_lens)
+    # every request owns a disjoint, shuffled run of physical blocks
+    perm = torch.randperm(num_blocks)[: len(q_lens) * max_blocks]
+    block_table = perm.view(len(q_lens), max_blocks).to(torch.int32)
+    return CommonAttentionMetadata(
+        query_start_loc=torch.tensor(qsl, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        query_start_loc_cpu=torch.tensor(qsl, dtype=torch.int32),
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+        num_reqs=len(q_lens),
+        num_actual_tokens=qsl[-1],
+        max_query_len=max(q_lens),
+        max_seq_len=max(seq_lens),
+        block_table_tensor=block_table.to(device),
+        slot_mapping=torch.zeros(qsl[-1], dtype=torch.long, device=device),
+        seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+
+
+def test_row_split(monkeypatch):
+    """Long requests go to the FMHA rows, the rest to a compact batch."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends import rocm_aiter_unified_attn as mod
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q", "64")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "on_gfx950", lambda: True)
+    cm = _metadata([4, 100, 1, 64], [1000, 300, 50, 64], "cpu", 64)
+    ext = mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, 1)
+    assert ext is not None
+    # query_start_loc = [0, 4, 104, 105, 169]
+    assert ext.long_tok.tolist() == list(range(4, 104)) + list(range(105, 169))
+    assert ext.long_cu_q.tolist() == [0, 100, 164]
+    assert ext.long_cu_k.tolist() == [0, 300, 364]
+    assert (ext.long_max_q, ext.long_max_k) == (100, 300)
+    # context rows of request 1 then request 3, each in token order
+    bt = cm.block_table_tensor.long()
+    t1, t3 = torch.arange(300), torch.arange(64)
+    want = torch.cat(
+        [bt[1, t1 // BLOCK] * BLOCK + t1 % BLOCK, bt[3, t3 // BLOCK] * BLOCK + t3]
+    )
+    assert torch.equal(ext.kv_rows, want)
+    assert ext.short_tok.tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3, 104]
+    assert ext.short_cu_q.tolist() == [0, 4, 5]
+    assert ext.short_seq_lens.tolist() == [1000, 50]
+    assert torch.equal(ext.short_block_table, cm.block_table_tensor[[0, 2]])
+
+    # spec decode rows (1 + 3 tokens) stay on unified attention at any threshold
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q", "4")
+    assert mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, 1).long_tok[0].item() == 0
+    ext = mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, 1, max_decode_q=4)
+    assert ext.short_tok.tolist() == [0, 1, 2, 3, 104]
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q", "0")
+    assert mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, 1) is None
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q", "200")
+    assert mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, 1) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm()
+    or current_platform.get_device_capability() != (9, 5),
+    reason="gfx950 only",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_kv_heads", [1, 2])
+def test_fmha_extend_matches_unified_attention(monkeypatch, num_kv_heads):
+    """The FMHA rows and the compact unified rows reproduce one unified call."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.unified_attention import unified_attention
+
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends import rocm_aiter_unified_attn as mod
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_UNIFIED_ATTN_FMHA_EXTEND_MIN_Q", "512")
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    fp8 = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+    q_heads = 8 * num_kv_heads
+    q_lens, seq_lens = [4, 1024, 4, 2048], [3000, 4096, 700, 2048]
+    num_blocks = 256
+    cm = _metadata(q_lens, seq_lens, dev, num_blocks)
+    kv_cache = (
+        torch.randn(num_blocks, num_kv_heads, BLOCK, 2 * HEAD, device=dev) * 0.5
+    ).to(fp8)
+    key_cache, value_cache = kv_cache.transpose(1, 2).split(HEAD, dim=-1)
+    query = (torch.randn(cm.num_actual_tokens, q_heads, HEAD, device=dev) * 0.5).to(fp8)
+    one = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(_q_scale=one, _k_scale=one, _v_scale=one)
+    scale = HEAD**-0.5
+
+    ref = torch.empty(query.shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+    unified_attention(
+        q=query,
+        k=key_cache,
+        v=value_cache,
+        out=ref,
+        cu_seqlens_q=cm.query_start_loc,
+        max_seqlen_q=cm.max_query_len,
+        seqused_k=cm.seq_lens,
+        max_seqlen_k=cm.max_seq_len,
+        softmax_scale=scale,
+        causal=True,
+        alibi_slopes=None,
+        window_size=(-1, -1),
+        block_table=cm.block_table_tensor,
+        softcap=0,
+        q_descale=one.view(1),
+        k_descale=one.view(1),
+        v_descale=one.view(1),
+        sinks=None,
+        output_scale=None,
+    )
+
+    ext = mod._build_fmha_extend(cm, BLOCK, num_kv_heads)
+    assert ext is not None and ext.short_tok is not None
+    impl = SimpleNamespace(head_size=HEAD, fp8_dtype=fp8, scale=scale)
+    out = torch.zeros_like(ref)
+    mod.RocmAiterUnifiedAttentionImpl._forward_fmha_extend(
+        impl, layer, query, kv_cache, out, ext
+    )
+    long_rows = ext.long_tok
+    cos = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
+        out[long_rows].float().flatten(), ref[long_rows].float().flatten(), dim=0
+    )
+    assert cos > 0.999, cos
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out[long_rows], ref[long_rows], atol=2e-2, rtol=0)

@@ -215,3 +215,54 @@ def fail(*args, **kwargs):
     assert after.keys() == before.keys()
     for name, tensor in before.items():
         assert torch.equal(after[name], tensor), name
+
+
+def _drafter(head: torch.nn.Module | None, has_own: bool) -> torch.nn.Module:
+    drafter = torch.nn.Module()
+    if head is not None:
+        drafter.lm_head = head
+    drafter.has_own_lm_head = has_own
+    return drafter
+
+
+@requires_cuda
+def test_own_head_drafter_quantizes_its_own_head(
+    default_vllm_config, dist_init, monkeypatch
+):
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import resolve_draft_lm_head
+
+    target, own = _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=0), _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=1)
+    drafter = _drafter(own, has_own=True)
+    resolve_draft_lm_head(drafter, torch.nn.Module(), target, "fp8")
+
+    assert drafter.lm_head is not own and drafter.lm_head is not target
+    assert drafter.lm_head.weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+    logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(VOCAB)
+    hidden = torch.randn(256, HIDDEN, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    out = logits_processor(drafter.lm_head, hidden).float()
+    own_ref = logits_processor(own, hidden).float()
+    target_ref = logits_processor(target, hidden).float()
+    # the copy follows the drafter's head, not the target's
+    assert (out - own_ref).norm() / own_ref.norm() < 0.05
+    assert (out - target_ref).norm() / target_ref.norm() > 0.5
+
+
+@requires_cuda
+def test_own_head_drafter_unquantized_keeps_its_head(
+    default_vllm_config, dist_init, monkeypatch
+):
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import resolve_draft_lm_head
+
+    target, own = _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=0), _target_head(monkeypatch, seed=1)
+    drafter = _drafter(own, has_own=True)
+    resolve_draft_lm_head(drafter, torch.nn.Module(), target, None)
+    assert drafter.lm_head is own
+
+
+def test_quantization_without_any_head_raises():
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.eagle.utils import resolve_draft_lm_head
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="drafter with an lm_head"):
+        resolve_draft_lm_head(
+            _drafter(None, has_own=True), torch.nn.Module(), None, "fp8"
+        )

@@ -461,11 +461,12 @@ class SpeculativeConfig:
     acceptance-rate impact of reusing that block. It does not disable the
     speculative drafter itself."""
     draft_lm_head_quantization: Literal["fp8", "nvfp4"] | None = None
-    """Quantize the drafter's copy of a target lm_head it shares (EAGLE and
-    MTP). "fp8" uses per-row weight and per-token activation scales on the
-    platform's FP8 linear kernel; "nvfp4" is weight-only on the platform's
